regions.tonight: Tonight will be cold with clear spells and a sharp frost in many areas. Lowest temperatures of -3 to +1 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Friday will start off cold and frosty in places. Frost will gradually clear. It will be mainly dry with bright or sunny spells in the morning. Cloud will increase from the west later in the day. Quite cold with highest temperatures of 6 to 9 degrees and light variable breezes.
